integrity: Both incidence-mask enumeration and independent triple-dynamic-program enumerations agree; source files and census are included. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact census for binary two-list codes with exactly two insertions or two deletions and input lengths 2 through 5 only; no larger lengths or asymptotic claim. Results rely on provided reproducible exhaustive programs. Equivalent unindexed finite classifications cannot be ruled out.
title: First finite two-list insertion–deletion separation for binary two-error codes
